name: Sliding log
summary: Keep every admitted request's timestamp and count the ones still inside the window. Exact, with no boundary effect, at a cost of one timestamp per permit per key.

complexity.space: O(limit) per key: each timestamp is written once and dropped once

params.name: limit
params.description: Requests allowed in any window of windowMs.

notes: The only limiter in this domain that enforces its limit exactly over every interval, and the most expensive.
